title: Folded Agricultural Threshing Flail
description: Original static agricultural threshing flail with long wooden handle, shorter thicker wooden beater, two fitted leather neck collars and one short leather connector. Five editable closed parts in a single folded resting pose. Actual joint anchors and wooden ground patches are checked, with lifted-tool and displaced-connector negatives. Reused intact grain sheaf and paving provide scale and preparation context only. No separated-grain result, crop-species, swing, impact, rope dynamics or operational safety claim.
